id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying auth users sync when firebase auth isn t enabled

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery behavior for Firebase Authentication configuration failures.
review.reason: Adds a permanent, non-retryable error mapping for Firebase Authentication configuration missing, accompanied by a test assertion. This distinguishes a configuration-dependent failure from transient authentication failures, preventing unnecessary retries and allowing the ingestion system to recognize and handle this specific permanent failure mode.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test of a specific error handling behavior. While the benefit of preventing unnecessary retries is clear, the exact operational impact and user benefit are not independently verified; this score reflects the implementation and test, not the realized outcome.
